an3.90:1.1: Tisso imā bhikkhave sikkhā. Katamā tisso? Adhisīlasikkhā, adhicittasikkhā, adhipaññāsikkhā.
an3.90:2.1: Katamā ca bhikkhave adhisīlasikkhā? Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti . . . pe (II.4.) . . . samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu. Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave adhisīlasikkhā.
an3.90:3.1: Katamā ca bhikkhave adhicittasikkhā? Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave adhicittasikkhā.
an3.90:4.1: Katamā ca bhikkhave adhipaññāsikkhā? Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati. Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave adhipaññāsikkhā. Imā kho bhikkhave tisso sikkhā ti.
an3.90:5.1: Adhisīlaṃ adhicittañ ca adhipaññañ ca viriyavā. Thāmavā dhitimā jhāyī sato guttindriyo care
an3.90:6.1: Yathā pure tathā pacchā yathā pacchā tathā pure Yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho
an3.90:7.1: Yathā divā tathā rattiṃ yathā rattiṃ tathā divā Abhibhuyya disā sabbā appamāṇasamādhinā
an3.90:8.1: Tam āhu sekhaṃ paṭipadaṃ atho saṃsuddhacāraṇaṃ Tam āhu loke sambuddhaṃ dhīraṃ paṭipadantaguṃ
an3.90:9.1: Viññāṇassa nirodhena taṇhakkhayavimuttino Pajjotass' eva nibbānaṃ vimokho hoti cetaso ti.
